# S4 — CartHarbor

> Fixture data. Not market evidence.

## Synthetic control text

Your weekend campaign created 417 abandoned carts.

The recovery sequence still opens with “We noticed you left something behind.”

CartHarbor groups fictional cart records by the reason a shopper stopped and prepares a matching email draft for the ecommerce manager to review. Its synthetic control label reports a 31% higher click rate than a generic reminder, but no live campaign or customer produced that number.

Choose the recovery path that matches the stated objection, check the draft, and schedule it in your existing email platform.

Build a sample recovery sequence.
